- [Real-Time Plasma Control](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/real-time-plasma-control.html): A fusion plasma changes on millisecond timescales, so control loops must sense, decide, and act faster than the instabilities they suppress.
- [Reconciling Models with the As-Built Machine](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/as-built-model-reconciliation.html): Hardware never matches the drawing exactly; measuring the real machine and updating the models keeps the digital twin honest.
- [Reduced-Order Models](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/reduced-order-models.html): A reduced-order model keeps the essential behavior of a heavy simulation while running fast enough for control and rapid analysis.
- [Reproducibility Runbooks](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/reproducibility-runbooks.html): A runbook records exactly how to reproduce a result, from environment to inputs to commands, so anyone can regenerate it later.
- [Scheduling Optimization for Maintenance](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/scheduling-optimization-maintenance.html): Planning maintenance activities to keep a plant available while respecting resource, access, and safety constraints.
- [Sensitivity Analysis](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/sensitivity-analysis-computing.html): Finding which inputs a result depends on most, to focus measurement, control, and design effort where it pays.
- [Sensitivity Analysis in Design](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/sensitivity-analysis-in-design.html): Sensitivity analysis ranks which inputs actually move the outcome, so effort and measurement go where they change the answer.
- [Sensor Fusion](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/sensor-fusion-computing.html): Combining many imperfect sensors into a single estimate that is more accurate and reliable than any one of them alone.
- [Simulation Data Management](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/simulation-data-management.html): Organizing, versioning, and finding the large, heterogeneous datasets that simulation campaigns produce.
- [Simulation-Based Inference](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/simulation-based-inference.html): When a model can simulate data but not write down a likelihood, simulation-based inference recovers the parameters that explain observations.
- [Supply-Chain Simulation for Isotopes](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/supply-chain-simulation-isotopes.html): Getting an isotope from irradiation to the end user is a timed, multi-step chain; simulating it keeps supply reliable against a decay clock.
- [Surrogate Models for Design](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/surrogate-models-for-design.html): Fast approximations of slow simulations that let engineers explore, optimize, and quantify uncertainty at scale.
- [Surrogate-Driven Optimization](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/surrogate-driven-optimization.html): A surrogate is a fast learned stand-in for a slow simulation, making optimization and uncertainty analysis affordable at scale.
- [Synthetic Diagnostics](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/synthetic-diagnostics.html): A synthetic diagnostic simulates what an instrument would measure from a modeled plasma, connecting simulation to real observation.
- [The 81-Analysis Reproducible Record](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/the-81-analysis-reproducible-record.html): A structured record of independent analyses, each reproducible from inputs to result, forms the evidence base behind the Kronos design.
- [The AI-Native Fusion Plant](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/the-ai-native-fusion-plant.html): An AI-native plant treats computation as a core subsystem, not an add-on: design, control, and operations share one model of the machine.
- [The Design-Build-Operate Data Loop](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/design-build-operate-loop.html): The feedback cycle in which operating data improves the next design, and design assumptions are tested against what the plant actually does.
- [The Diagnostics Data Pipeline](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/data-pipeline-for-diagnostics.html): Raw diagnostic signals become usable knowledge only after a pipeline synchronizes, calibrates, labels, and routes them reliably.
- [The Disruption-Free Operation Strategy](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/disruption-free-operation-strategy.html): Reliable operation is not one trick but a layered strategy combining prediction, avoidance, control, and safe termination.
- [The Intelligence Flywheel Across Design, Build, Operate](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/the-intelligence-flywheel.html): Each phase produces data that improves the models used in the next, so knowledge compounds from design through build to operation.
- [The Licensing Evidence Package](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/licensing-evidence-package.html): The analyses, records, and traceability a regulator needs are assembled into one growing, auditable package as the design matures.
- [The Reproducible-Science Pipeline as a Moat](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/reproducible-science-pipeline.html): A workflow where any published result can be rebuilt bit-for-bit from recorded inputs, code, and environment.
- [Transfer Learning Across Devices](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/transfer-learning-across-devices.html): Models trained on existing fusion devices give Kronos machines a head start, provided the transfer respects where the physics differs.
- [Tritium Breeding Ratio Optimization](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/tritium-breeding-optimization-tbr.html): A D-T plant must breed more tritium than it burns; the breeding ratio is a computational optimization of blanket geometry and materials.
- [Tritium Inventory Management](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/tritium-inventory-management.html): Tritium is bred, burned, stored, and lost continuously; accounting for every gram in real time is a safety and operations requirement.
- [Tritium Permeation Modeling](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/tritium-permeation-modeling.html): Predicting how tritium moves through hot metal walls, a loss path and a containment concern the fuel cycle must account for.
- [Uncertainty Quantification in Engineering](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/uncertainty-quantification-applications.html): Turning point predictions into honest ranges by tracking how input uncertainty and model error propagate to outputs.
- [Uncertainty-Driven Engineering Decisions](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/uncertainty-driven-engineering-decisions.html): Every simulation output is a distribution, not a number; good engineering decisions weigh the spread, not just the central value.
- [Verification, Validation, and Uncertainty Quantification](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/verification-validation-uq-vvuq.html): VVUQ answers three separate questions: is the code solved right, does the model match reality, and how confident are the results.
- [What Computing Does for Kronos: An Overview](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/computing-across-the-program-overview.html): A single view of how computation runs through every phase of the Kronos program, from first design sweep to plant operation.
- [Worked Example: A Space-Filling Design](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/worked-example-latin-hypercube.html): A short, concrete look at how a space-filling design spreads sample points across a configuration space before any simulation runs.

### Worked Examples
- [1D Poisson by Finite Differences](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/poisson-1d-finite-difference.html): Discretize a boundary-value problem into a tridiagonal system and solve for the potential across the interval.
- [A Gaussian-Process Posterior Update](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/gaussian-process-posterior.html): Condition a Gaussian process on three observations and compute the predictive mean and variance at a new input by hand.
- [A Linear Kalman Filter Update](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/kalman-filter-linear-update.html): Run one predict-update cycle of a scalar Kalman filter, computing the gain that optimally blends prediction and measurement.
- [A Naive Bayes Classifier by Hand](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/naive-bayes-toy.html): Classify with Bayes' rule under a strong independence assumption, worked on a small spam-style example.
- [A Particle-in-Cell Push-and-Weight Step](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/pic-push-weight.html): Advance one macro-particle with the Boris rotation, deposit its charge to the grid, and see the core loop of a PIC plasma code.
- [A Small Cooley-Tukey FFT](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/fft-cooley-tukey-small.html): Compute an 8-point discrete Fourier transform by recursively splitting even and odd samples - the divide-and-conquer that made spectral methods practical.
- [A Trotter Step Error Estimate](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/trotter-step-error.html): Approximate the evolution of two non-commuting Hamiltonian terms with a first-order Trotter split and bound the step error.
- [A k-Means Clustering Trace](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/k-means-trace.html): Run Lloyd's algorithm on six points with two clusters, alternating assignment and mean update until the centers stop moving.
- [An Adam Optimizer Step](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/adam-optimizer-step.html): Apply one Adam update with worked numbers, tracking the bias-corrected first and second moment estimates.
- [An Ensemble Kalman Filter Update](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/ensemble-kalman-update.html): Assimilate one noisy observation into a small ensemble, computing the Kalman gain from sample statistics and nudging each member.
- [An Importance Sampling Estimate](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/importance-sampling-estimate.html): Estimate a rare-event probability far more efficiently by sampling from a shifted distribution and reweighting.
- [Backpropagation Through a Tiny MLP](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/backprop-tiny-mlp.html): Compute the forward pass and every gradient of a two-layer network on one example, entirely by hand.
- [Backpropagation Through a Two-Layer Network](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/backprop-2-layer-network.html): Derive and code the gradients of a small neural network by applying the chain rule backward from the loss.
- [Bernstein-Vazirani: Reading a Hidden String](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/bernstein-vazirani-worked.html): Recover an n-bit secret string with a single oracle query where classical methods need n.
- [Bloom Filter False-Positive Rate](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/bloom-filter-false-positive.html): Build a small Bloom filter, insert a few keys, and compute the probability of a false positive from its parameters.
- [Building a Bell State Step by Step](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/bell-state-step-by-step.html): Construct the maximally entangled two-qubit Bell state with one Hadamard and one CNOT, tracking the amplitudes at each step.
- [Building a Full Adder from NAND Gates](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/full-adder-nand-gates.html): Compose a one-bit full adder entirely from NAND gates, showing how a single universal gate builds arithmetic.
- [Building a POD Reduced-Order Model](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/pod-reduced-order-model.html): Compress a set of simulation snapshots into a handful of proper-orthogonal-decomposition modes and quantify the energy each mode captures.
- [Choosing a Decision-Tree Split by Entropy](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/decision-tree-entropy-split.html): Pick the feature and threshold that most reduce label impurity, the greedy step that grows a decision tree.
- [Computing Sobol Sensitivity Indices](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/sobol-sensitivity-indices.html): Decompose the variance of a model output among its inputs to rank which parameters actually drive uncertainty.
- [Computing a Singular Value Decomposition](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/compute-svd-worked.html): Factor a small matrix into rotation, scaling, and rotation, and read off rank, range, and the best low-rank approximation.
- [Conjugate Gradient on a Small SPD System](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/conjugate-gradient-solve.html): Solve a symmetric positive-definite linear system with conjugate gradient and watch it converge in at most n steps.
- [Crank-Nicolson for 1D Diffusion](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/crank-nicolson-diffusion.html): Step a 1D heat equation with the unconditionally stable Crank-Nicolson scheme by solving a tridiagonal system each step.
- [Crank-Nicolson for the Heat Equation](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/crank-nicolson-heat.html): Trade an explicit stability limit for an unconditionally stable, second-order-in-time implicit scheme that solves a tridiagonal system each step.
- [Deutsch-Jozsa in One Query](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/deutsch-jozsa-worked.html): Decide whether a black-box function is constant or balanced with a single evaluation instead of exponentially many.
- [Estimating Pi by Monte Carlo](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/monte-carlo-estimate-pi.html): Throw random darts at a square, count how many land in the inscribed circle, and read off pi - with a 1/sqrt(N) error.
- [Evaluating a Disruption Predictor (ROC)](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/disruption-predictor-roc.html): Score a binary classifier that flags impending plasma disruptions, sweep the threshold, and build the ROC curve with its area.
- [FFT of a Sampled Signal](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/fft-sampled-signal.html): Sample a two-tone signal, take its discrete Fourier transform, and read the frequency peaks and bin resolution directly.
- [Finite Element Solution of a 1D Bar](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/fe-1d-bar.html): Solve axial displacement of an elastic bar under load using two linear elements and assemble the global stiffness system by hand.
- [Finite-Differencing the 1D Heat Equation](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/heat-equation-1d-fd.html): Solve u_t = alpha u_xx on a rod with an explicit forward-time centered-space scheme, and watch the stability limit bite.
- [Finite-Differencing the 1D Wave Equation](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/wave-equation-1d-fd.html): March a vibrating string forward with a leapfrog scheme and meet the Courant condition that keeps it stable.
- [Fitting a Gaussian Process](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/gaussian-process-fit.html): Interpolate noisy data with a Gaussian process that returns not just predictions but calibrated uncertainty.
- [Gauss-Seidel Iteration](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/gauss-seidel-iteration.html): Speed up Jacobi by using each updated value the moment it is computed within the same sweep.
- [Gradient Descent on a Quadratic Bowl](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/gradient-descent-quadratic.html): Minimize a simple quadratic to build intuition for step size, convergence rate, and why conditioning matters.
- [Hamming(7,4) Encode and Decode](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/hamming-7-4-decode.html): Encode four data bits into a seven-bit codeword, inject a single-bit error, and locate it from the syndrome.
- [Huffman Coding a Small Alphabet](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/huffman-coding-small.html): Build an optimal prefix code for four symbols with known frequencies and compute the average code length.
- [Integrating an ODE with RK4](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rk4-integrate-ode.html): Advance a differential equation using the classic fourth-order Runge-Kutta method and see why its error shrinks as the step to the fourth power.
- [Kalman-Filtering a Noisy Signal](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/kalman-filter-noisy-signal.html): Fuse a noisy model prediction with a noisy measurement to track a hidden state optimally, step by step.
- [Knapsack via Dynamic Programming](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/knapsack-dynamic-programming.html): Fill the 0/1 knapsack table for four items and a small capacity, then backtrack to recover which items the optimum selects.
- [LU Decomposition Worked by Hand](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/lu-decomposition-worked.html): Factor a matrix into lower and upper triangular pieces so many linear systems can be solved with cheap back-substitution.
- [LU Decomposition with Partial Pivoting](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/lu-partial-pivoting.html): Factor a small matrix into permuted lower- and upper-triangular factors, then solve a system by forward and back substitution.
- [Linear Regression via the Normal Equations](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/linear-regression-normal-equations.html): Fit a line to data by solving a small linear system, and understand why the QR route is numerically safer.
- [Logistic Regression by Gradient Descent](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/logistic-regression-gd.html): Classify data with a sigmoid model trained on cross-entropy loss, deriving the clean gradient by hand.
- [Metropolis-Hastings Sampling a Gaussian](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/metropolis-hastings-gaussian.html): Draw samples from a target distribution using a random-walk proposal and the accept-reject rule, then check the sample statistics.
- [Monte Carlo Estimate of Pi](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/monte-carlo-pi.html): Estimate pi by sampling points in a square, count the fraction inside the inscribed circle, and quantify the error scaling.
- [Newton's Method for a Root](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/newtons-method-root.html): Find where a function crosses zero by repeatedly following its tangent line, and watch the error square each step.
- [Newton-Raphson on a Nonlinear System](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/newton-raphson-system.html): Solve two coupled nonlinear equations by iterating the Jacobian-based Newton update, and watch quadratic convergence.
- [Numerical Integration with Simpson's Rule](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/simpson-rule-integration.html): Approximate a definite integral by fitting parabolas over pairs of intervals, achieving fourth-order accuracy for smooth functions.
- [One Gradient-Boosting Round](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/gradient-boosting-round.html): Fit a shallow tree to the residuals of a constant predictor and watch a single boosting round shrink the loss.
- [One MPC Optimization Step](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mpc-one-step.html): Solve a single model-predictive-control problem: minimize a quadratic cost over a short horizon, apply only the first control, then repeat.
- [One Particle-in-Cell Time Step](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/particle-in-cell-step.html): Walk through the four-phase PIC cycle - deposit, solve, gather, push - that plasma codes repeat millions of times.
- [One Surface-Code Error-Correction Cycle](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/surface-code-cycle.html): Walk a single stabilizer measurement round of a small surface code, inject one bit-flip error, and show how the syndrome localizes it.
- [PCA on a Small Dataset](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/pca-small-dataset.html): Center a small dataset, compute its covariance eigenvectors, and project onto the leading principal component.
- [PID vs LQR on a Mass-Spring](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/pid-vs-lqr-mass-spring.html): Control a damped mass-spring to a setpoint with a tuned PID loop and with an optimal LQR gain, and compare the closed-loop behavior.
- [Power Iteration for the Dominant Eigenvalue](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/power-iteration-eigenvalue.html): Repeatedly multiply a vector by a matrix and normalize to converge on its largest-magnitude eigenvalue and eigenvector.
- [Preparing a GHZ State on Three Qubits](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/ghz-state-three-qubits.html): Extend the Bell recipe to three qubits to build the GHZ state, the simplest genuine multipartite entangled state.
- [Principal Component Analysis on Toy Data](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/pca-toy-data.html): Find the directions of maximum variance by taking the eigenvectors of the covariance matrix, and project to fewer dimensions.
- [QR Decomposition by Gram-Schmidt](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qr-gram-schmidt.html): Orthonormalize a matrix's columns to factor it into an orthogonal Q and upper-triangular R - the basis of stable least squares.
- [Quantum Phase Estimation Worked Out](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/phase-estimation-worked.html): Estimate the eigenphase of a unitary using a counting register, controlled powers, and an inverse QFT.
- [RK4 Orbit Integration](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rk4-orbit-integration.html): Integrate a circular two-body orbit with the fourth-order Runge-Kutta method and check energy drift over one period.
- [Reading a Confusion Matrix and ROC Curve](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/confusion-matrix-roc.html): Evaluate a classifier honestly with counts of the four outcome types and the threshold-sweep ROC curve.
- [Running Grover Search on Three Qubits](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/grover-3-qubits.html): Search an 8-item unstructured database in a single Grover iteration, amplifying the marked state from 1/8 to near-certainty.
- [SVD of a 2x2 Matrix](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/svd-2x2.html): Compute the singular value decomposition of a small matrix from its symmetric products and verify the reconstruction.
- [Sampling with Metropolis-Hastings](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/metropolis-hastings-sampling.html): Draw samples from a distribution you can only evaluate up to a constant, using a random walk with an accept-reject rule.
- [Simulated Annealing on a Toy Problem](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/simulated-annealing-toy.html): Escape local minima by accepting uphill moves with a probability that cools over time, mimicking metallurgical annealing.
- [Simulating a 2-Qubit Grover Search](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/grover-2-qubit.html): Run one Grover iteration on a two-qubit register to amplify a marked state and reach it with certainty.
- [Solving a Linear System by Jacobi Iteration](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/jacobi-iteration-linear.html): Solve Ax = b without factoring the matrix by repeatedly updating each unknown from the previous sweep's values.
- [Solving the 2D Heat Equation](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/heat-equation-2d.html): March a discretized 2D diffusion problem forward in time with an explicit five-point stencil, and check the stability limit that constrains the time step.
- [Solving the Grad-Shafranov Equation Numerically](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/grad-shafranov-numerical.html): Compute a tokamak plasma equilibrium by iterating the Grad-Shafranov elliptic PDE on a grid until the flux converges.
- [The Bisection Method](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/bisection-method-root.html): Bracket a root between a sign change and halve the interval until it is pinned down - slow but guaranteed.
- [The Bisection Method](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/bisection-root-find.html): Bracket a root, halve the interval repeatedly, and converge to a solution with guaranteed but linear reliability.
- [The Conjugate Gradient Method](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/conjugate-gradient-worked.html): Solve a symmetric positive-definite system in at most n steps by searching along mutually conjugate directions.
- [The Forward Euler Method](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/euler-method-ode.html): The simplest ODE integrator: step along the current slope, and understand exactly how its error and stability behave.
- [The Quantum Fourier Transform on Three Qubits](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/qft-3-qubits.html): Trace the QFT gate by gate on three qubits, showing the Hadamard-and-controlled-phase ladder and the final qubit swap.
- [The Quantum Teleportation Circuit](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-teleportation-circuit.html): Move an unknown qubit state across a shared Bell pair using two classical bits and local corrections.
- [The Secant Method](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/secant-method-root.html): Get near-Newton speed without computing a derivative by approximating the slope from two recent points.
- [The Shooting Method for a Boundary-Value Problem](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/shooting-method-bvp.html): Turn a two-point boundary-value problem into a root-finding problem on the unknown initial slope.
- [The Softmax Cross-Entropy Gradient](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/softmax-cross-entropy-gradient.html): Turn logits into class probabilities and derive why the combined gradient collapses to predicted-minus-target.
- [The Trapezoidal Rule, Worked](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/trapezoidal-integration.html): Estimate an integral by summing trapezoids under the curve, and understand its second-order error and one surprising strength.
- [The VQE Energy Curve for H2](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/vqe-h2-energy-curve.html): Sweep the bond length of the hydrogen molecule and minimize a two-parameter ansatz to trace the ground-state energy well.
- [Tracing A* on a Grid](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/a-star-grid-trace.html): Search a small grid with obstacles using A*, combining path cost and a heuristic to find the shortest route efficiently.
- [Tracing Dijkstra on a Small Graph](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/dijkstra-trace.html): Follow Dijkstra's shortest-path algorithm node by node on a five-vertex weighted graph, watching the tentative distances settle.
- [Training a Small CNN on Toy Images](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/cnn-toy-images.html): Build and train a compact convolutional network to separate two synthetic image classes, and read the convergence from the loss curve.
- [Training a Tiny Disruption Classifier](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/train-tiny-disruption-classifier.html): Build a small logistic classifier that flags impending plasma disruptions from a few diagnostic features - a scaled-down version of a real fusion control task.
- [Transformer Self-Attention Computed by Hand](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/self-attention-by-hand.html): Work a single self-attention head through query-key scores, softmax weights, and value mixing on three short tokens with tiny vectors.
- [Trotterizing a Simple Hamiltonian](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/trotterize-simple-hamiltonian.html): Approximate time evolution under a sum of non-commuting terms by splitting it into small, easy-to-simulate steps.
- [Tuning a PID Control Loop](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/tune-pid-loop.html): Drive a process to a setpoint with proportional, integral, and derivative terms, and understand what each knob does.
- [VQE for the Hydrogen Molecule](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/vqe-h2-molecule.html): Estimate the ground-state energy of H2 with a variational quantum eigensolver: a parameterised circuit plus a classical optimizer.
- [Verlet Integration of an Orbit](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/verlet-integration-orbit.html): Simulate a planet around a star with velocity Verlet and see why symplectic integrators conserve energy over long runs.
- [k-Means Clustering on Toy Data](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/kmeans-toy-data.html): Partition points into k groups by alternating between assigning points to nearest centers and recomputing those centers.

### Glossary
- [Activation Function](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/activation-function.html): The nonlinear function applied at each neuron that lets networks represent nonlinear relationships.
- [Adder Circuit](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/adder-circuit-glossary.html): A combinational circuit that adds binary numbers, the arithmetic core of a processor.
- [Algorithm](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/algorithm-glossary.html): A finite, unambiguous procedure that transforms inputs into outputs to solve a problem.
- [Amdahl's Law](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/amdahls-law.html): A formula bounding the speedup from parallelization by the fraction of work that stays sequential.
- [Arithmetic Logic Unit](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/alu-glossary.html): The processor component that performs arithmetic and logical operations on binary data.
- [Artificial Intelligence](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/artificial-intelligence.html): The field of building systems that perform tasks normally requiring human intelligence, from perception to reasoning and control.
- [Autoencoder](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/autoencoder.html): A neural network trained to reconstruct its input through a compressed bottleneck, learning efficient representations.
- [Big-O Notation](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/big-o-notation-glossary.html): A notation describing how an algorithm's resource use grows with input size, ignoring constants.
- [Binary Number System](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/binary-number-system-glossary.html): Base-2 representation using only 0 and 1, the native language of digital hardware.
- [Boolean Algebra](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/boolean-algebra-glossary.html): The algebra of true/false values and the logical operations that combine them, the mathematical basis of digital design.
- [Cache Memory](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/cache-memory.html): Small, fast memory close to the processor that holds recently used data to hide slow main-memory access.
- [Clustering](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/clustering.html): Grouping data points so that members of a group are more similar to each other than to points in other groups.
- [Combinational Logic](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/combinational-logic-glossary.html): Digital logic whose outputs depend only on the current inputs, with no memory of the past.
- [Control Theory](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/control-theory.html): The mathematics of steering dynamic systems toward desired behavior using feedback.
- [Controllability and Observability](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/observability-controllability.html): Two structural properties defining whether a system can be fully steered and fully inferred.
- [Convolutional Neural Network](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/convolutional-neural-network.html): A neural network that shares small learnable filters across an input to detect local patterns efficiently.
- [Correlation](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/correlation-glossary.html): A measure of how strongly two variables move together, and a caution against inferring causation.
- [Data Pipeline](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/data-pipeline-glossary.html): An automated sequence of steps that moves and transforms data from sources to a usable form.
- [Data Structure](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/data-structure.html): A way of organizing data in memory to support efficient access and modification.
- [Database](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/database.html): An organized collection of data with a system for efficient storage, query, and update.
- [Decision Tree](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/decision-tree.html): A model that predicts by following a sequence of feature-based yes/no splits from a root to a leaf.
- [Deep Learning](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/deep-learning.html): Machine learning with many-layered neural networks that learn hierarchical features directly from raw data.
- [Diffusion Model](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/diffusion-model.html): A generative model that learns to reverse a gradual noising process, turning noise into realistic samples.
- [Digital Twin](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/digital-twin-glossary.html): A continuously updated virtual model of a physical system, used for analysis, monitoring, and prediction.
- [Dijkstra's Algorithm](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/dijkstra-algorithm.html): A graph algorithm that finds shortest paths from one node to all others with non-negative edge weights.
- [Dimensionality Reduction](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/dimensionality-reduction.html): Mapping high-dimensional data to fewer dimensions while preserving its important structure.
- [Distributed Computing](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/distributed-computing.html): Coordinating many networked computers, each with its own memory, to work on a common task.
- [Eigenvalue Problem](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/eigenvalue-problem.html): Finding the special vectors a matrix only scales, and the scaling factors, which reveal a system's modes.
- [Embedding](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/embedding.html): A learned mapping of discrete items into a continuous vector space where geometry encodes meaning.
- [Ensemble Learning](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/ensemble-learning.html): Combining multiple models so their collective prediction beats any single one.
- [Epoch, Batch, Iteration](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/epoch-batch-iteration.html): The three units that describe how much data a training run has processed.
- [FLOPS](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/flops.html): A measure of computing performance counting floating-point operations per second.
- [Fast Fourier Transform](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/fast-fourier-transform.html): An algorithm that computes the discrete Fourier transform in O(n log n) instead of O(n squared) time.
- [Feedback Loop](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/feedback-loop.html): A control arrangement where a system's output is measured and fed back to adjust its input.
- [Fine-Tuning](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/fine-tuning.html): Continuing training of a pretrained model on a smaller, task-specific dataset to specialize it.
- [Finite State Machine](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/finite-state-machine-glossary.html): A model of computation with a finite set of states and rules for transitioning between them on inputs.
- [Flip-Flop](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/flip-flop-glossary.html): A one-bit memory element that holds its state until a clock edge tells it to update.
- [Floating Point](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/floating-point-glossary.html): A binary format representing real numbers as a sign, a fractional mantissa, and an exponent.
- [Floating-Point Error](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/floating-point-error.html): The inaccuracy introduced when real numbers are stored and computed with finite precision.
- [Fourier Transform](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/fourier-transform.html): A transform that expresses a signal as a sum of sinusoids, revealing its frequency content.
- [GPU Computing](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/gpu-computing.html): Using graphics processors' massive parallelism to accelerate general numerical computation.
- [Generative Adversarial Network](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/generative-adversarial-network.html): Two networks trained against each other: a generator that fakes data and a discriminator that detects fakes.
- [Graph Algorithm](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/graph-algorithm.html): Algorithms that operate on graphs of nodes and edges to answer questions about connectivity and paths.
- [Greedy Algorithm](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/greedy-algorithm.html): An algorithm that builds a solution step by step, always taking the locally best choice.
- [Grover's Algorithm](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/grover-algorithm.html): A quantum search algorithm that finds an item in an unsorted list with a quadratic speedup.
- [Hash Table](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/hash-table.html): A data structure that maps keys to values with near-constant-time lookup using a hash function.
- [Hidden Markov Model](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/hidden-markov-model.html): A model of sequences generated by hidden states that transition over time and emit observable outputs.
- [Hyperparameter](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/hyperparameter.html): A configuration value set before training that governs how a model learns, not learned from the data itself.
- [Interpolation](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/interpolation.html): Estimating values between known data points by fitting a function that passes through them.
- [Karnaugh Map](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/karnaugh-map-glossary.html): A grid method for simplifying Boolean expressions by grouping adjacent terms visually.
- [Large Language Model](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/large-language-model.html): A transformer trained on vast text to predict the next token, gaining broad language and reasoning ability.
- [Linear Solver](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/linear-solver.html): An algorithm that solves a system of linear equations, the core computation in most simulations.
- [Linked List](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/linked-list.html): A sequence of nodes each pointing to the next, allowing efficient insertion without contiguous memory.
- [Load Balancing](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/load-balancing.html): Distributing work evenly across processors or machines so none sits idle while others are overloaded.
- [Logic Gate](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/logic-gate-glossary.html): A physical device implementing a basic Boolean operation, the hardware atom of digital computation.
- [Loss Function](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/loss-function.html): The scalar objective a model minimizes, quantifying how far predictions are from targets.
- [Machine Learning](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/machine-learning.html): A family of methods that fit models to data so they generalize to unseen inputs, rather than following hand-written rules.
- [Message Passing Interface](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mpi.html): The standard programming model for communication between processes in distributed-memory parallel computing.
- [Monte Carlo Method](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/monte-carlo-method.html): A family of methods that estimate quantities by averaging over many random samples.
- [Multiplexer](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/multiplexer-glossary.html): A circuit that selects one of several inputs to pass to its single output, steered by select lines.
- [NP-Completeness](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/np-completeness-glossary.html): A class of problems believed to have no efficient exact algorithm, all reducible to one another.
- [Neural Network](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/neural-network.html): A model of layered, weighted connections between simple units that together approximate complex functions.
- [Newton-Raphson Method](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/newton-raphson.html): An iterative method that finds roots of a function using its derivative, converging quadratically near a solution.
- [Numerical Analysis](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/numerical-analysis.html): The study of algorithms that compute approximate solutions to mathematical problems, with control of error.
- [Numerical Integration](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/numerical-integration.html): Approximating a definite integral or advancing a differential equation using discrete sums.
- [Overfitting](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/overfitting.html): When a model fits the training data's noise and fails to generalize to new data.
- [PID Controller](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/pid-controller.html): A widely used feedback controller that combines proportional, integral, and derivative terms to correct error.
- [Parallel Computing](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/parallel-computing.html): Performing many computations simultaneously by dividing work across multiple processors.
- [Physics-Informed Neural Network](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/physics-informed-neural-network.html): A neural network trained to satisfy governing physical equations, not just fit data.
- [Policy Gradient](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/policy-gradient.html): A reinforcement learning approach that optimizes a parameterized policy directly by gradient ascent on expected reward.
- [Precision and Recall](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/precision-recall.html): Two complementary metrics capturing how accurate a classifier's positive calls are and how many positives it finds.
- [Principal Component Analysis](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/pca-glossary.html): A linear method that finds orthogonal directions of greatest variance to compress or explain data.
- [Q-Learning](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/reinforcement-q-learning.html): A model-free reinforcement learning method that learns the value of actions to derive an optimal policy.
- [Quantum Circuit](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-circuit.html): A sequence of quantum gates applied to qubits to carry out a quantum computation.
- [Quantum Decoherence](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-decoherence.html): The loss of a quantum system's coherence as it interacts with its environment, destroying superposition.
- [Quantum Error Correction](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-error-correction.html): Encoding logical qubits across many physical qubits to detect and correct errors without measuring the data.
- [Quantum Gate](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-gate.html): A reversible operation that transforms qubit states, the building block of quantum circuits.
- [Quantum Simulation](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-simulation.html): Using a controllable quantum system to model another quantum system that is hard to simulate classically.
- [Quantum Supremacy](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quantum-supremacy.html): The demonstration that a quantum computer performs a task no classical computer can do in feasible time.
- [Random Forest](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/random-forest.html): An ensemble of decorrelated decision trees whose averaged predictions are more accurate and stable than any single tree.
- [Recurrent Neural Network](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/recurrent-neural-network.html): A neural network with feedback connections that maintains state to process sequences of varying length.
- [Recursion](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/recursion-glossary.html): A technique where a function solves a problem by calling itself on smaller instances.
- [Register](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/register-glossary.html): A small, fast storage element inside a processor that holds data being actively worked on.
- [Regression Analysis](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/regression-analysis.html): Statistical modeling of the relationship between a dependent variable and one or more predictors.
- [Reinforcement Learning](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/reinforcement-learning.html): Learning a policy that maximizes cumulative reward by interacting with an environment through trial and error.
- [Reproducibility](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/reproducibility.html): The ability to obtain the same results by re-running an analysis with the same data and methods.
- [Runge-Kutta Methods](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/runge-kutta.html): A family of methods for accurately integrating ordinary differential equations step by step.
- [SQL](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/sql-glossary.html): A declarative language for querying and manipulating data in relational databases.
- [Scalability](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/scalability.html): How well a system's performance improves as resources or problem size grow.
- [Sequential Logic](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/sequential-logic-glossary.html): Digital logic whose outputs depend on both current inputs and stored past state.
- [Shor's Algorithm](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/shor-algorithm.html): A quantum algorithm that factors large integers exponentially faster than known classical methods.
- [Signal Processing](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/signal-processing.html): The analysis, filtering, and transformation of signals to extract information or improve quality.
- [Softmax](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/softmax.html): A function that turns a vector of scores into a probability distribution over classes.
- [Sorting Algorithm](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/sorting-algorithm.html): A procedure for arranging elements in order, a foundational and well-studied computing task.
- [Spectral Method](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/spectral-method-glossary.html): A numerical method that represents a solution as a sum of global basis functions for high accuracy.
- [Stability](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/stability-control.html): The property that a system's response stays bounded and returns to equilibrium after a disturbance.
- [Stack and Queue](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/stack-queue.html): Two ordered collections defined by their access discipline: last-in-first-out and first-in-first-out.
- [State Space](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/state-space.html): A representation of a dynamic system by a set of state variables evolving through first-order equations.
- [Support Vector Machine](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/support-vector-machine.html): A classifier that finds the boundary with the widest margin between classes, extended to nonlinear cases with kernels.
- [Surrogate Model](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/surrogate-model.html): A fast approximation trained to mimic an expensive simulation or experiment.
- [Time Complexity](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/time-complexity-glossary.html): A measure of how an algorithm's running time scales with the size of its input.
- [Time Series](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/time-series.html): Data indexed in time order, analyzed to find trends, cycles, and to forecast future values.
- [Tokenization](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/tokenization.html): Splitting text into the discrete units a language model reads and predicts.
- [Transfer Function](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/transfer-function.html): A frequency-domain description of how a linear system maps input to output.
- [Transformer](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/transformer.html): A sequence architecture built on attention that processes all positions in parallel and scales to very large models.
- [Tree Data Structure](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/tree-data-structure.html): A hierarchical data structure of nodes with a root and branching children, enabling fast ordered operations.
- [Truth Table](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/truth-table-glossary.html): A table listing a logic function's output for every possible combination of its inputs.
- [Two's Complement](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/twos-complement-glossary.html): The standard way to represent signed integers in binary so that addition works uniformly.
- [Vanishing Gradient](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/gradient-vanishing.html): The failure of gradients to propagate through deep or recurrent networks, stalling learning in early layers.
- [Vectorization](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/vectorization.html): Restructuring computation so a processor performs one operation on many data elements at once.
- [Verification and Validation](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/verification-validation.html): Two distinct checks: that a model is solved correctly, and that it represents reality.
- [k-Means](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/k-means.html): A clustering algorithm that partitions data into k groups by iteratively minimizing distance to cluster centers.

### Classical Algorithms
- [2-SAT](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/two-sat.html): Deciding satisfiability of boolean formulas with two literals per clause in linear time via implication graphs.
- [A* Search](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/a-star.html): A* finds a shortest path to a goal by guiding Dijkstra's search with an admissible heuristic that estimates the remaining distance.
- [AVL Trees](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/avl-tree.html): An AVL tree is a binary search tree that keeps every node's subtrees within one level of each other, guaranteeing O(log n) operations.
- [Aho-Corasick Algorithm](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/aho-corasick.html): A multi-pattern string matcher that builds an automaton over a trie with failure links to scan text in linear time.
- [Amortized Analysis](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/amortized-analysis.html): Bounding the average cost per operation across a worst-case sequence, even when individual operations are occasionally expensive.
- [Andrew's Monotone Chain](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/andrew-monotone-chain-hull.html): A convex hull algorithm that sorts points by coordinate and builds the lower and upper hulls in one linear pass each.
- [Arrays](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/arrays.html): An array stores a fixed number of equal-size elements in one contiguous block, giving constant-time access by index.
- [B+ Tree](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/b-plus-tree.html): A high-fanout balanced tree that stores all data in the leaves and links them for range scans, standard in databases and filesystems.
- [B-Trees](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/b-tree.html): A B-tree is a balanced search tree with many keys per node, tuned to minimise disk reads for databases and file systems.
- [Backtracking](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/backtracking.html): Backtracking builds candidate solutions incrementally and abandons a partial candidate as soon as it cannot be completed.
- [Bellman-Ford Algorithm](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/bellman-ford.html): Bellman-Ford computes shortest paths even with negative edge weights and detects negative cycles, at a cost of O(V*E).
- [Binary Heaps](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/binary-heap.html): A binary heap is a complete binary tree stored in an array that keeps the smallest or largest element at the root for O(log n) updates.
- [Binary Search](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/binary-search.html): Binary search halves a sorted array each step to find a target in O(log n), the classic payoff for keeping data ordered.
- [Binary Search Trees](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/binary-search-tree.html): A binary search tree keeps keys ordered so search, insertion, and deletion cost O(h) where h is the height, ideally O(log n).
- [Binary Trees](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/binary-trees.html): A binary tree gives each node at most two children, forming the structural basis for search trees, heaps, and expression trees.
- [Bloom Filter](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/bloom-filter.html): A space-efficient probabilistic set that answers membership with no false negatives and a tunable false-positive rate.
- [Boyer-Moore String Search](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/boyer-moore-string-search.html): A pattern-matching algorithm that scans right to left and skips large sections of text using two shift heuristics.
- [Breadth-First Search](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/breadth-first-search.html): Breadth-first search explores a graph level by level from a source, finding shortest paths in unweighted graphs in O(V + E).
- [Bubble Sort](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/bubble-sort.html): Bubble sort repeatedly swaps adjacent out-of-order pairs; simple to understand but O(n^2) and rarely used in practice.
- [Computational Geometry Basics](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/computational-geometry-basics.html): The core predicates and primitives - orientation, intersection, and distance - underlying geometric algorithms.
- [Computing Fibonacci Numbers](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/fibonacci-algorithms.html): The Fibonacci sequence illustrates the leap from exponential naive recursion to linear dynamic programming and logarithmic matrix methods.
- [Counting Sort](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/counting-sort.html): Counting sort tallies how many of each key value occur, then places elements directly, sorting in linear time for a small key range.
- [Depth-First Search](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/depth-first-search.html): Depth-first search plunges as deep as possible before backtracking, revealing graph structure in O(V + E) time.
- [Deques](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/deques.html): A double-ended queue supports constant-time insertion and removal at both ends, generalising both the stack and the queue.
- [Dijkstra's Algorithm](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/dijkstra.html): Dijkstra's algorithm finds shortest paths from a source in a graph with non-negative edge weights using a priority queue.
- [Dinic's Algorithm](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/dinic-algorithm.html): A layered max-flow algorithm that augments blocking flows per phase, reaching strong worst-case bounds.
- [Divide and Conquer](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/divide-and-conquer.html): Divide and conquer splits a problem into independent subproblems, solves them recursively, and combines their answers.
- [Doubly Linked Lists](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/doubly-linked-lists.html): A doubly linked list adds a backward pointer to each node, allowing traversal in both directions and O(1) deletion given only the node.
- [Dynamic Arrays](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/dynamic-arrays.html): A dynamic array grows automatically by reallocating to a larger block, giving amortized constant-time append on top of a fixed array.
- [Edit Distance](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/edit-distance.html): Edit distance counts the fewest single-character insertions, deletions, and substitutions needed to turn one string into another.
- [Edmonds-Karp Algorithm](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/edmonds-karp-algorithm.html): Ford-Fulkerson with breadth-first shortest augmenting paths, giving a capacity-independent polynomial bound.
- [Euler Tour Technique](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/euler-tour-technique.html): Flattening a tree into an array by recording entry and exit times, turning subtree and path problems into range problems.
- [Extended Euclidean Algorithm](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/extended-euclidean-algorithm.html): Computing the greatest common divisor of two integers together with the coefficients of Bezout's identity.
- [External Sorting](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/external-sorting.html): Sorting data too large for memory by merging sorted runs read from and written to external storage.
- [Fast Fourier Transform](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/fast-fourier-transform-algorithm.html): A divide-and-conquer algorithm that computes the discrete Fourier transform in O(n log n), enabling fast convolution.
- [Fenwick Tree (Binary Indexed Tree)](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/fenwick-binary-indexed-tree.html): A compact array structure that maintains prefix aggregates with logarithmic update and query using the low-bit trick.
- [Fibonacci Heap](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/fibonacci-heap.html): A priority queue with O(1) amortized insert and decrease-key, improving the theoretical bound of Dijkstra and Prim.
- [Floyd-Warshall Algorithm](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/floyd-warshall.html): Floyd-Warshall computes shortest paths between all pairs of vertices with a triple loop, in O(V^3) time.
- [Ford-Fulkerson Method](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/ford-fulkerson-method.html): The foundational augmenting-path scheme for computing maximum flow in a capacitated network.
- [Graham Scan (Convex Hull)](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/graham-scan-convex-hull.html): An angular-sort sweep that computes the convex hull of a planar point set in O(n log n) time.
- [Graph Representations](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/graph-representations.html): A graph can be stored as an adjacency matrix or an adjacency list; the choice trades memory against the cost of listing a vertex's neighbours.
- [Hash Collisions](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/hash-collisions.html): When two keys hash to the same bucket, a collision-resolution scheme keeps operations correct and fast; chaining and open addressing are the two families.
- [Hash Tables](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/hash-tables.html): A hash table maps keys to slots through a hash function, delivering expected constant-time insertion, lookup, and deletion.
- [Hashing](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/hashing.html): A hash function maps arbitrary data to a fixed-size integer; good hashing spreads inputs uniformly and underlies tables, caches, and fingerprints.
- [Heapsort](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/heap-sort.html): Heapsort builds a max-heap and repeatedly extracts the largest element, giving guaranteed O(n log n) sorting in place.
- [Heavy-Light Decomposition](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/heavy-light-decomposition.html): Splitting a tree into chains so that any root-to-node path crosses only logarithmically many chains, enabling fast path queries.
- [Hopcroft-Karp Matching](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/hopcroft-karp-matching.html): The fastest classical algorithm for maximum matching in bipartite graphs, augmenting many shortest paths per phase.
- [Hungarian Algorithm](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/hungarian-algorithm.html): A combinatorial method that finds a minimum-cost perfect matching in a weighted bipartite graph in polynomial time.
- [Insertion Sort](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/insertion-sort.html): Insertion sort builds a sorted prefix one element at a time; O(n^2) overall but fast on small or nearly sorted arrays.
- [KMP String Matching](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/kmp-string-matching.html): The Knuth-Morris-Pratt algorithm finds a pattern in text in linear time by never re-examining characters, using a failure function.
- [Karger's Min-Cut Algorithm](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/karger-min-cut.html): A randomized contraction algorithm that finds a global minimum cut of an undirected graph with high probability.
- [Knuth-Morris-Pratt](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/knuth-morris-pratt.html): A linear-time single-pattern string search that never re-examines text characters, using a precomputed prefix-failure table.
- [Kosaraju's Algorithm](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/kosaraju-scc.html): A two-pass depth-first method for strongly connected components using the graph and its transpose.
- [Kruskal's Algorithm](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/kruskal-algorithm.html): Kruskal's algorithm builds a minimum spanning tree by adding edges in weight order, skipping any that would form a cycle.
- [LFU Cache](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/lfu-cache.html): A cache that evicts the least-frequently-used entry, favoring items accessed often over items accessed merely recently.
- [LRU Cache](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/lru-cache.html): A fixed-capacity cache that evicts the least-recently-used entry, giving O(1) get and put with a hash map and linked list.
- [Line Sweep Technique](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/line-sweep-technique.html): A paradigm that solves geometric problems by moving an imaginary line across the plane and processing events in order.
- [Linear Search](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/linear-search.html): Linear search scans a collection element by element until it finds the target, costing O(n) but requiring no ordering or preprocessing.
- [Linked Lists](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/linked-lists.html): A linked list chains elements through pointers so insertion and deletion cost constant time, at the price of losing random access.
- [Longest Common Subsequence](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/longest-common-subsequence.html): The longest common subsequence finds the longest ordering of characters shared by two strings, solved with a two-dimensional DP table.
- [Lowest Common Ancestor](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/lowest-common-ancestor.html): Finding the deepest node that is an ancestor of two given nodes in a tree, with several preprocessing strategies.
- [Manacher's Algorithm](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/manacher-algorithm.html): Finding all palindromic substrings, and the longest palindrome, in linear time by reusing mirror symmetry.
- [Matrix Exponentiation](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/matrix-exponentiation.html): Raising a transition matrix to a large power by repeated squaring to evaluate linear recurrences in logarithmic time.
- [Max-Flow Min-Cut Theorem](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/max-flow-min-cut-theorem.html): The duality result stating that the maximum s-t flow equals the minimum-capacity s-t cut in any network.
- [Meet in the Middle](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/meet-in-the-middle.html): A technique that halves the exponent of brute force by splitting the search, solving both halves, and combining results.
- [Memoization](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/memoization.html): Memoization caches the results of function calls so repeated calls with the same arguments return instantly instead of recomputing.
- [Merge Sort](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/merge-sort.html): Merge sort splits the array in half, sorts each recursively, and merges the two sorted halves, guaranteeing O(n log n) and stability.
- [Min-Cost Max-Flow](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/min-cost-max-flow.html): Finding a maximum flow of minimum total cost by repeatedly augmenting along shortest-cost paths in the residual graph.
- [Minimum Spanning Trees](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/minimum-spanning-tree.html): A minimum spanning tree connects all vertices of a weighted graph with the least total edge weight and no cycles.
- [Mo's Algorithm](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mos-algorithm.html): Answering many offline range queries efficiently by reordering them to minimize the movement of two pointers.
- [Modular Exponentiation](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/modular-exponentiation.html): Computing a base raised to a large power modulo m in logarithmic time by repeated squaring.
- [Persistent Data Structures](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/persistent-data-structures.html): Structures that preserve every previous version after an update, allowing queries against any point in their history.
- [Prim's Algorithm](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/prim-algorithm.html): Prim's algorithm grows a minimum spanning tree from a start vertex, always adding the cheapest edge that reaches a new vertex.
- [Priority Queues](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/priority-queue.html): A priority queue serves elements by priority rather than arrival order, usually implemented with a binary heap.
- [Queues](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/queues.html): A queue is a first-in-first-out container with constant-time enqueue and dequeue, the natural structure for fair, in-order processing.
- [Quicksort](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quicksort.html): Quicksort partitions around a pivot and recurses on each side; O(n log n) on average with excellent constants, though O(n^2) in the worst case.
- [Rabin-Karp Algorithm](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/rabin-karp.html): A hashing-based string search that slides a rolling hash to find pattern occurrences, extending naturally to multiple patterns.
- [Radix Sort](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/radix-sort.html): Radix sort orders integers digit by digit using a stable counting sort per digit, achieving linear time when the key width is bounded.
- [Recursion](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/recursion.html): Recursion solves a problem by having a function call itself on smaller instances until it reaches a base case.
- [Red-Black Tree](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/red-black-tree.html): A self-balancing binary search tree that keeps height logarithmic using node colors and a small set of rotation rules.
- [Reservoir Sampling](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/reservoir-sampling.html): Drawing a uniform random sample of fixed size from a stream of unknown length in a single pass.
- [Segment Tree](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/segment-tree.html): A balanced binary tree over an array that answers range queries and point or range updates in logarithmic time.
- [Selection Sort](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/selection-sort.html): Selection sort repeatedly picks the smallest remaining element and places it next; O(n^2) but with the fewest possible writes.
- [Sieve of Eratosthenes](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/sieve-of-eratosthenes.html): An ancient method that finds all primes up to n by iteratively marking multiples of each prime as composite.
- [Skip List](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/skip-list.html): A randomized ordered structure of layered linked lists giving expected logarithmic search, insert, and delete.
- [Sparse Table (Range Minimum Query)](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/sparse-table-rmq.html): A precomputed table that answers idempotent range queries such as minimum in constant time on a static array.
- [Splay Tree](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/splay-tree.html): A self-adjusting binary search tree that moves each accessed node to the root, giving strong amortized guarantees.
- [Stacks](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/stacks.html): A stack is a last-in-first-out container with constant-time push and pop, the natural structure for nested and reversible work.
- [String Hashing and Fingerprints](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/string-hashing.html): Polynomial rolling hashes turn strings into integers that can be compared and updated in constant time, powering fast substring algorithms.
- [Strongly Connected Components](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/strongly-connected-components.html): A strongly connected component is a maximal set of vertices where every vertex can reach every other; they are found in linear time.
- [Suffix Array](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/suffix-array.html): A sorted array of all suffix starting positions of a string, giving compact full-text indexing and fast substring search.
- [Suffix Automaton](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/suffix-automaton.html): The smallest deterministic automaton recognizing every substring of a string, built online in linear time.
- [Suffix Trees](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/suffix-trees.html): A suffix tree indexes all suffixes of a string in a compressed trie, answering many substring queries in time independent of the text length.
- [Tarjan's Strongly Connected Components](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/tarjan-scc.html): A single-pass depth-first algorithm that finds all strongly connected components of a directed graph in linear time.
- [The Knapsack Problem](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/knapsack-problem.html): The 0/1 knapsack problem picks a subset of items with maximum value under a weight limit, solved by dynamic programming.
- [The Sorting Lower Bound](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/sorting-lower-bound.html): Any sort that orders by comparing keys must make at least on the order of n log n comparisons in the worst case.
- [Topological Sort](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/topological-sort.html): A topological sort orders the vertices of a directed acyclic graph so every edge points forward, respecting all dependencies.
- [Treap](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/treap.html): A randomized balanced BST that couples binary-search-tree keys with heap-ordered random priorities for expected logarithmic height.
- [Tree Traversals](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/tree-traversals.html): Tree traversals visit every node in a defined order: pre-order, in-order, and post-order for depth, and level-order for breadth.
- [Trie (Prefix Tree)](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/trie-prefix-tree.html): A tree keyed on shared prefixes that stores a set of strings for fast prefix search, autocomplete, and dictionary lookup.
- [Tries](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/tries.html): A trie stores strings by their characters along tree paths, giving lookup time proportional to key length rather than the number of keys.
- [Union-Find](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/union-find.html): The union-find structure tracks a partition into disjoint sets, answering connectivity queries in near-constant amortized time.
- [Union-Find (Disjoint-Set Union)](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/union-find-disjoint-set.html): A near-constant-time structure that maintains a partition of elements into disjoint sets, supporting merge and same-set queries.
- [Z-Algorithm](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/z-algorithm.html): A linear-time method that computes, for each position, the length of the longest substring starting there that matches a prefix.
- [k-d Tree](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/kd-tree.html): A binary space-partitioning tree that organizes points in k dimensions for nearest-neighbor and range search.

### Fusion Equations
- [Alfven Wave Equations](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/alfven-wave-equations.html): The transverse magnetic-tension wave of MHD, and the eigenmodes it forms in a nonuniform confined plasma.
- [Alfven Waves](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/alfven-waves.html): Transverse waves that travel along magnetic field lines as if they were tensioned strings.
- [Ambipolar Diffusion](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/ambipolar-diffusion.html): The self-regulating diffusion in which electrons and ions leave together at a common rate set by a self-consistent field.
- [Banana Orbits](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/banana-orbits.html): The crescent-shaped guiding-center paths of trapped particles that dominate neoclassical transport.
- [Bohm Diffusion](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/bohm-diffusion.html): An early empirical scaling for anomalous cross-field transport, unusually fast and only weakly field-dependent.
- [Braginskii Transport Coefficients](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/braginskii-transport-coefficients.html): The closed set of collisional fluid transport coefficients for a magnetized two-fluid plasma.
- [Bremsstrahlung Radiation](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/bremsstrahlung-radiation.html): The braking radiation emitted when electrons are deflected by ions, an unavoidable energy loss from any plasma.
- [Collisionality nu-star](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/collisionality-nu-star.html): The dimensionless ratio that places a plasma in the banana, plateau, or Pfirsch-Schluter transport regime.
- [Coulomb Collision Frequency](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/collision-frequency.html): The rate at which cumulative small-angle Coulomb encounters deflect a charged particle by a large angle.
- [Cyclotron and Synchrotron Radiation](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/cyclotron-radiation.html): Radiation emitted by electrons gyrating in the magnetic field, a loss that grows with field and temperature.
- [Direct Energy Conversion Equations](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/direct-energy-conversion.html): How charged fusion products can be decelerated against an electric field to produce electricity without a thermal cycle.
- [Dispersion Relations](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/dispersion-relations.html): The relation between frequency and wavevector that classifies every linear wave and instability in a plasma.
- [Drift Waves and Turbulence](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/drift-wave-turbulence.html): The universal instabilities driven by density and temperature gradients that dominate cross-field transport.
- [Drift-Wave Instability](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/drift-wave-instability.html): The universal instability driven by density and temperature gradients, the seed of most plasma turbulence.
- [Energy Confinement Scaling Laws](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/energy-confinement-scaling.html): Empirical power-law fits that predict confinement time from machine size, field, current, and heating.
- [Fusion Reactivity and Reaction Rate](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/fusion-reactivity.html): The velocity-averaged product of cross section and speed that sets how fast a fuel mixture fuses.
- [Guiding-Center Drifts](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/guiding-center-drifts.html): The slow motion of a particle's gyration center across field lines under crossed forces and field gradients.
- [Gyro-Bohm Transport](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/gyro-bohm-transport.html): The favorable turbulence scaling in which diffusivity shrinks with the normalized gyroradius.
- [Gyrofrequency and Plasma Frequency](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/gyrofrequency-and-plasma-frequency.html): The two fundamental frequencies of a plasma: gyration about field lines and collective electrostatic oscillation.
- [Hall Magnetohydrodynamics](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/hall-mhd.html): An extension of MHD that retains the Hall term, decoupling ion and electron motion at small scales.
- [Ideal-Wall and No-Wall Beta Limits](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/wall-stabilized-beta-limits.html): The two pressure ceilings set by external kink stability, with and without a perfectly conducting boundary.
- [Landau Damping](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/landau-damping.html): Collisionless damping of a plasma wave by resonant particles moving near the wave's phase velocity.
- [Larmor Radius and Gyrofrequency](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/larmor-radius-gyrofrequency.html): The size and rate of a charged particle's spiral around a magnetic field line, the basic scales of magnetization.
- [MHD Equilibrium and Force Balance](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mhd-equilibrium-force-balance.html): The static balance grad p = J x B that every confined plasma must satisfy at each instant.
- [Magnetic Flux Surfaces](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/magnetic-flux-surfaces.html): The nested toroidal surfaces traced by field lines, on which pressure and temperature are constant.
- [Magnetic Mirror Confinement Equations](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mirror-confinement-equations.html): The invariants and loss-cone conditions that govern how a converging magnetic field traps charged particles.
- [Magnetic Shear](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/magnetic-shear.html): The radial variation of the field-line pitch, a primary stabilizing ingredient for pressure-driven and current-driven instabilities.
- [Magnetohydrodynamic Waves](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/mhd-waves.html): The three fundamental linear wave modes of a magnetized conducting fluid: shear Alfven, fast, and slow magnetosonic.
- [Magnetosonic Waves](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/magnetosonic-waves.html): The compressional fast and slow MHD waves in which magnetic and thermal pressure jointly provide restoring force.
- [Maxwell's Equations in Plasmas](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/maxwell-equations-plasma.html): The four field equations that, coupled to charged-particle motion, govern all electromagnetic behavior of a plasma.
- [Mirror Ratio and the Loss Cone](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/magnetic-mirror-ratio.html): How the ratio of peak to minimum field defines which particles are trapped and which escape a magnetic mirror.
- [Neoclassical Transport](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/neoclassical-transport-overview.html): Collisional transport enhanced by toroidal geometry and trapped-particle orbits, the irreducible floor beneath turbulent losses.
- [Neoclassical Transport](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/neoclassical-transport.html): Collisional transport enhanced by toroidal geometry and trapped-particle orbits, the irreducible confinement floor.
- [Normalized Gyroradius rho-star](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/normalized-gyroradius-rho-star.html): The ratio of the ion gyroradius to the plasma size, the key parameter for scaling turbulent transport across devices.
- [Peeling-Ballooning Modes and the Edge Pedestal](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/peeling-ballooning-elm.html): The coupled current- and pressure-driven instability that limits the edge transport barrier and triggers ELMs.
- [Pfirsch-Schluter Transport](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/pfirsch-schluter-transport.html): The high-collisionality neoclassical regime, where parallel return currents enhance cross-field diffusion by roughly q squared.
- [Plasma Beta](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/plasma-beta.html): The ratio of plasma pressure to magnetic pressure, the key measure of how efficiently a field confines plasma.
- [Plasma Power Balance](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/power-balance-equations.html): The accounting of heating and loss terms that determines whether a plasma sustains its temperature.
- [Plasma Transport Equations](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/plasma-transport-equations.html): The evolution equations for density, temperature, and current profiles on the slow confinement timescale.
- [Poloidal Beta](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/poloidal-beta.html): The ratio of plasma pressure to the pressure of the poloidal magnetic field, a key equilibrium and stability parameter.
- [Pressure Balance and Plasma Diamagnetism](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/pressure-balance-diamagnetism.html): How a plasma reduces the internal magnetic field to make room for its own pressure.
- [Quasilinear Theory](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/quasilinear-theory.html): A weak-turbulence framework in which a spectrum of small waves slowly reshapes the background distribution through velocity-space diffusion.
- [Resistive MHD](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/resistive-mhd.html): MHD with finite resistivity, which breaks the frozen-in law and permits reconnection and tearing modes.
- [Sawtooth Oscillations and Reconnection](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/sawtooth-kadomtsev.html): Periodic internal crashes that flatten the core when the central safety factor drops below one.
- [Spitzer Resistivity](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/spitzer-resistivity.html): The collisional electrical resistivity of a fully ionized plasma, falling steeply as temperature rises.
- [Tearing Mode Stability](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/tearing-mode-stability.html): The resistive instability that reconnects field lines into magnetic islands at rational surfaces.
- [The Ballooning Equation](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/ballooning-equation.html): The eigenvalue equation for pressure-driven MHD modes that localize on the outboard, bad-curvature side.
- [The Ballooning-Mode Equation](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/ballooning-mode-equation.html): The high-mode-number pressure-driven instability that localizes on the bad-curvature outboard side.
- [The Banana Regime](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/banana-regime-transport.html): Low-collisionality neoclassical transport set by the wide banana orbits of trapped particles.
- [The Boltzmann Equation](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/boltzmann-equation.html): The founding kinetic transport equation, evolving a distribution function under streaming, forces, and a collision integral.
- [The Bootstrap Current](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/bootstrap-current.html): A self-generated toroidal current driven by the plasma pressure gradient through trapped-particle dynamics.
- [The Braginskii Equations](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/braginskii-equations.html): The classic collisional two-fluid transport equations with explicit magnetized transport coefficients.
- [The Continuity Equation](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/continuity-equation-fluid.html): The conservation-of-mass equation for a plasma fluid, the first moment of the kinetic equation.
- [The Coulomb Logarithm](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/coulomb-logarithm.html): The slowly varying factor that captures the dominance of many small-angle collisions in a plasma.
- [The Current Diffusion Equation](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/current-diffusion-equation.html): The resistive-diffusion equation that evolves the poloidal flux and hence the safety-factor profile.
- [The Debye Length](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/debye-length.html): The distance over which a plasma screens out electric fields, the fundamental scale of quasi-neutrality.
- [The Diffusion Equation](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/diffusion-equation.html): A parabolic partial differential equation describing how a conserved quantity spreads down its own gradient over time.
- [The Drift-Kinetic Equation](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/drift-kinetic-equation.html): The long-wavelength limit of gyrokinetics, following guiding centers under slow drifts and collisions.
- [The Eikonal and Ray-Tracing Equations](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/ai/eikonal-ray-tracing-equations.html): The short-wavelength approximation that turns wave propagation into the trajectories of rays through a plasma.
